visual_findings: Title, authors, DOI, abstract and ESI-availability footnote.
Scheme 1 equations (1)-(3) are cited prior literature examples.
Scheme 1 blue equation (4) is a conceptual three-branch map: [2+2], allenic-C-H ene and allylic-C-H ene.
Scheme 2 contains three arrows: 1a to 2a (73%), 1b decomposition/2b 0%, and 1c to 2c (58%), each with toluene, 90 °C, 8 h.
Prose identifies 2a as Alder-ene and 2c as the exclusive [2+2] cycloadduct; it states decomposition for 1b.
Prose enumerates Table 1 and Table 2 outcomes but their row structures and footnotes occur on later pages.
Table 1 has nine numbered rows with yields 63, 0, 0, 64, 60, 55, 62, 34 and 58 percent.
Header conditions are toluene, 90 °C, 6-8 h; footnote a says isolated yield.
Rows 2 and 3 carry both b and c: thermal decomposition and an additional decomposition experiment in toluene at 55 °C with 5 mol% AgSbF6.
Table 2 has eight numbered rows; rows 1-2 are decomposition and each also has the footnote-c AgSbF6/55 °C experiment; rows 3-6 use 90 °C, 6-7 h; rows 7-8 use 150 °C, 12 h.
Table 3 has ten numbered rows under toluene, 150 °C, 12 h: six isolated-yield [2+2] products and four decomposition rows.
Table 3 row 10 prints expected-product label 8gc, while the prose refers collectively to expected 8ga-8gd.
Scheme 3 contains five generic trend arrows, equations (5)-(9), not concrete experiments.
Conclusion summarizes selectivity; right column begins acknowledgements and references.
Both columns are bibliography continuation only; no current-paper experiment, table, footnote condition or characterization dataset appears.

limitations: Complex graphical structures were retained by paper-local label and source evidence rather than converted to uncertified SMILES.
No SI file was supplied or explicitly associated.
Inspection of pages 1-6 is an attempted extraction, not a claim of complete chemical correctness.
